test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A camp has provisions for 42 pupils for 12 days. In how many days will the same provisions finish off if the strength of the camp is increased to 63 pupils?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Inverse Proportion: More pupils → Fewer days.

Product constant: M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

42 × 12 = 63 × Days

Days = (42 × 12) ÷ 63 = 504 ÷ 63 = 8 days

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Initial Pupils (M₁) = 42, Initial Days (D₁) = 12, New Pupils (M₂) = 63

Formula: Total Provisions = Number of Pupils × Number of Days

 42 Pupils → 12 Days 63 Pupils → x Days 
• Total Provisions = 42 × 12 = 504 pupil-days ⇒ M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂ ⇒ 42 × 12 = 63 × D₂ ⇒ 504 = 63 × D₂ ⇒ D₂ = 504 ÷ 63 ⇒ D₂ = 8

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

When one value increases while the other decreases such that their product remains constant. Formula: x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂.

Work & Time Relationship

The number of workers and the time taken to complete a fixed amount of work are inversely proportional.

Chain Rule

General formula for work problems: (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂, where H is hours and W is work.
